# Clegra apps

> Clegra's developer platform: apps that are also MCP servers. One typed object — `defineApp({ entities, actions, pages, fragments, agents, … })` from the package `clegra` — becomes a plain, conformant MCP server with tools, annotations, MCP Apps views and OAuth (for ChatGPT, Claude and any MCP client) and a JSON manifest Clegra reads to draw the app natively in its workspace. No MCP extension required.

## Start here

- [AI guide](ai-guide.md): the complete single-file reference for coding agents — the whole `defineApp` shape, the rules, the common mistakes, a full example. Read this one file to build an app.

## More

- [Specification](spec.md): the manifest, kinds and cross-app references, the generated MCP server, enforcement, conformance, the workspace host across apps (normative, short)
- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): Next.js in 5 minutes (`npx clegra init`), a day to ship; standalone Node; tests
- [UI](ui.md): `clegra/ui`, Clegra's components for React and React Native, the theme and `<ClegraProvider>` for an app's own view; `npx clegra init --ui`, Tailwind 4 setup, tokens
- [Auth](auth.md): your sign-in as the authorization server, your `auth.resolve`; recipes for better-auth, Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS
- [CRM example](examples/crm.md): Next.js, better-auth, Drizzle; code in `examples/apps/crm/clegra/app.ts`
- [Warehouse example](examples/warehouse.md): Next.js, better-auth, plain SQL; code in `examples/apps/warehouse/lib/clegra.ts`
- JSON Schema of the manifest: `packages/clegra/spec/schema/clegra.schema.json`
- The kinds of this version (person, organization, event, task, document, product, order): `packages/clegra/spec/kinds.json`
